title: Builder BLD-203: Layout chips with needs and pins

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-203.

detail: B2 Roles, pass BLD-203 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-203). Layout chips with needs and pins. Scope: components/builder/canvas/variants. Build: Chips from variants with thumb; a chip whose needs are unmet shows why and a shortcut to fill the slot. Picking a chip sets variant and variantSet: true and shows a pin. Unpin restores the theme default via roleVariant(). Done when: roleVariant priority holds: owner, then theme, then role default; Every variant renders non-empty with sample content on every theme. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), audit:themes render matrix, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-201, BLD-104. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-203.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
